cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.21)

project(StreamClient VERSION 1.0.0 LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_AUTOMOC ON)

find_package(Qt6 6.5 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Core Gui Qml Quick QuickControls2 Network Multimedia Svg)

qt_standard_project_setup(REQUIRES 6.5)

# qmllint, with the policy in `.qmllint.ini`.  It runs after the module is
# built, because the module description it resolves `Stream` against is
# generated by `qt_add_qml_module` below -- pointing a linter at the source
# directory tells it the module does not exist, and every type in the project
# is then an unknown name.
#
# A non-zero exit fails the build.  QML's mistakes are runtime failures the
# compiler cannot see, and this is the only thing standing between a typo and a
# blank screen.
qt_add_executable(stream-client
    src/main.cpp
    src/apiclient.cpp
    src/apiclient.h
    src/apierror.cpp
    src/apierror.h
    src/credentialstore.cpp
    src/credentialstore.h
    src/credentialaccessmanager.cpp
    src/credentialaccessmanager.h
    src/sessioncontroller.cpp
    src/sessioncontroller.h
    src/librarymodel.cpp
    src/librarymodel.h
    src/homescreenmodel.cpp
    src/homescreenmodel.h
    src/appcontroller.cpp
    src/appcontroller.h
    src/playbackcontroller.cpp
    src/playbackcontroller.h
)

target_compile_definitions(stream-client PRIVATE
    QT_NO_CAST_FROM_ASCII
)

# The C++ types the UI names.  `qmlRegisterUncreatableType` in main.cpp makes
# them usable at runtime, but it happens long after CMake has collected the
# source list -- so without this, the generated module description contains no
# `AppController`, and qmllint reports every `AppController.Settings` and every
# property on `controller` as an unresolved name.  Listing the headers here is
# what puts their properties and enums into `qmltypes`.
set(STREAM_QML_SOURCES
    src/appcontroller.h
    src/sessioncontroller.h
    src/playbackcontroller.h
    src/librarymodel.h
    src/homescreenmodel.h
)

# Singletons: one instance, one source of truth.  Without this, every
# `Theme`/`Responsive` reference would construct a fresh QtObject and the
# tokens would not be shared.  The properties have to be set before the module
# is declared: qt_add_qml_module reads them while collecting the file list.
set_source_files_properties(qml/Theme.qml PROPERTIES QT_QML_SINGLETON_TYPE TRUE)
set_source_files_properties(qml/ui/Responsive.qml PROPERTIES QT_QML_SINGLETON_TYPE TRUE)
set_source_files_properties(qml/App.qml PROPERTIES QT_QML_SINGLETON_TYPE TRUE)

# `STREAM_QML_FILES` is also the list the linter runs over, so a new screen
# cannot be written without being linted.  See client/lint.sh for the flags.
#
# A warning is an error here.  QML's mistakes -- an unqualified identifier, a
# renamed property, a type that does not exist -- are runtime failures that the
# compiler cannot see, so the linter is the only thing standing between a typo
# and a blank screen.  Two kinds are exempted and neither is a QML defect:
# `pragma Singleton` files (the linter parses them in singleton mode and then
# resolves unqualified uses of them anyway), and the deliberately-unqualified
# context properties, which the `App` singleton exists to replace.
set(STREAM_QML_FILES
    qml/Main.qml
    qml/Shell.qml
    qml/Theme.qml
    qml/App.qml
    qml/ui/Responsive.qml
    qml/ui/AppButton.qml
    qml/ui/AppTextField.qml
    qml/ui/Icon.qml
    qml/ui/NavItem.qml
    qml/ui/PosterCard.qml
    qml/ui/PosterRail.qml
    qml/ui/StatusPane.qml
    qml/ui/FactList.qml
    qml/ui/FilterBar.qml
    qml/ui/ChangePasswordScreen.qml
    qml/screens/ServerScreen.qml
    qml/screens/LoginScreen.qml
    qml/screens/ProfileScreen.qml
    qml/screens/HomeScreen.qml
    qml/screens/MediaGridScreen.qml
    qml/screens/SearchScreen.qml
    qml/screens/DetailScreen.qml
    qml/screens/SettingsScreen.qml
    qml/screens/PlayerScreen.qml
)

qt_add_qml_module(stream-client
    URI Stream
    VERSION 1.0
    # The headers, not just the .qml files: a class annotated QML_ELEMENT is
    # only described to tooling if its header is a source *of the module*.
    SOURCES ${STREAM_QML_SOURCES}
    QML_FILES ${STREAM_QML_FILES}
)


target_include_directories(stream-client PRIVATE src)
target_link_libraries(stream-client PRIVATE
    Qt6::Core
    Qt6::Gui
    Qt6::Quick
    Qt6::QuickControls2
    Qt6::Network
    Qt6::Multimedia
    Qt6::Svg
)

# -- lint ------------------------------------------------------------------
# `find_program` still lives here, but the command has to come after the
# executable exists.
find_program(STREAM_QMLLINT NAMES qmllint-qt6 qmllint
             HINTS /usr/lib64/qt6/bin /usr/lib/qt6/bin
                   /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/qt6/bin)
if(STREAM_QMLLINT)
    add_custom_command(TARGET stream-client POST_BUILD
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E env
                QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen
                ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/lint.sh
        COMMENT "qmllint: checking the QML module")
    # The script needs the generated module description, which exists only
    # after the build; without this dependency a clean tree lints nothing.
    else()
    message(WARNING
        "qmllint not found; the QML module will not be linted. "
        "Install the Qt 6 development tools to get it back.")
endif()

# Tests are built only when asked for.  A client build on a packaging machine
# should not need the test sources to be present.
option(STREAM_BUILD_TESTS "Build the client test suite" OFF)
if(STREAM_BUILD_TESTS)
    enable_testing()
    add_subdirectory(tests)
endif()
